Portuguese (Brazil / Portugal) data for Lexi Conquest, 2026-11-07

Regional spelling validation:
- Brazil: VERO 3.2, Raimundo Santos Moura and contributors, copyright 2006–2013.
  LibreOffice dictionaries commit c0865a85eb67dc377f2cf8e8fe2c4fa9e53f0dcb.
  README explicitly offers GNU LGPL version 3 and an unspecified MPL version.
  We use LGPL-3.0, not an assumed MPL version. Original unmodified pt_BR.aff,
  pt_BR.dic, README, LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 license texts are in ../pt-BR/.
  https://github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/tree/c0865a85eb67dc377f2cf8e8fe2c4fa9e53f0dcb/pt_BR
- Portugal: Natura, José João de Almeida, Rui Vilela, Alberto Simões,
  Departamento de Informática, Universidade do Minho, copyright 2006–2009.
  hunspell-pt_PT-20251001 is the post-AO1990 release, not the separate preao archive.
  README/COPYING offers GPL-2.0, LGPL-2.1 or MPL-1.1; we use MPL-1.1.
  Original unmodified pt_PT.aff, pt_PT.dic, README and full COPYING are in ../pt-PT/.
  https://natura.di.uminho.pt/download/sources/Dictionaries/hunspell/hunspell-pt_PT-20251001.tar.gz

Lexical spellings and English senses:
Wiktionary contributors, English Wiktionary Portuguese entries, CC BY-SA 4.0.
https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Snapshot: https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Portuguese/kaikki.org-dictionary-Portuguese.jsonl
Original headword links are retained in each displayed definition. Only selected
plain-text lexical senses, labels and form references are used; examples,
quotations, media and etymologies are omitted. Exact article revisions were not
provided by the snapshot. Definitions are separate from regional spelling tests.

Frequency data: wordfreq 3.0.2, Robyn Speer and contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 data.
https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq/tree/372f6dbb3bd2ad4b675a3b18b94d44d0dd5fea8b
The software is MIT; this does not relicense its frequency data.

Changes: lowercase Portuguese lexical spellings of 3–11 letters are filtered by
historical spelling frequency, checked against exact headwords in the selected regional dictionary, with one
explicit VERO CASA form proven from the CASAR source row. No complete affix
expansion is claimed. Candidate answers receive explicit review. Accents
and cedilla are retained in answer identities and ignored in gameplay keys.
Collision audits and regional membership evidence are separate from meanings.
This is starter coverage, not an exhaustive dictionary or native-human review.

The repository's MIT code license does not replace these data licenses.
Wiktionary/wordfreq lexical evidence, selected lexical spellings, English senses
and their modifications retain CC BY-SA 4.0. VERO and Natura source files and
regional membership evidence retain their respective LGPL-3.0 / MPL-1.1 rights;
no blanket relicensing is intended. All dictionary sources supplied here are
unmodified. The corresponding source, modification scripts, membership reports,
reviews, hashes and generation instructions are supplied in the project under
src/data/portuguese/, scripts/import-portuguese.py, scripts/generate-portuguese.mjs
and docs/portuguese-sources.md. Source and modifications remain available under
their applicable licenses; there is no restriction on modifying/replacing these
files for personal use or distributing them under those licenses.
